summary.zh: 把半成品交到对的人手里，比每个人各做一道菜更有效。
summary.en: Handing off components can outperform every chef doing a whole dish.

rules.zh: 厨师共享空间和工作站，角色可按备料、加热、送餐分工。半成品需要明确交接；阻塞的台面、错放的材料和同时抢设备会制造拥堵。
rules.en: Chefs share space and stations and can specialize in preparation, cooking or service. Components need clear handoffs; blocked counters, misplaced items and contested equipment create congestion.

loop.en: Pass it or use a buffer

decisions.zh: 固定岗位减少沟通，还是随瓶颈临时换班？
decisions.en: Use fixed roles or rotate to the current bottleneck?

decisions.zh: 用最短路线抢道，还是绕路保持其他人的流量？
decisions.en: Take the shortest path or leave a lane open for teammates?

effect.zh: 窄路强化协调，也容易把错误放大为互相阻挡。
effect.en: Narrow lanes intensify coordination but magnify blocking.

effect.zh: 可投掷能跨越障碍；只能贴身传递更依赖布局。
effect.en: Throwing bridges obstacles; short-range handoffs depend more on layout.

contrast.zh: 胡闹厨房让团队适应设计好的障碍；PlateUp 允许团队先改空间，再执行分工。
contrast.en: Overcooked asks teams to adapt to authored obstacles; PlateUp lets them reshape space before dividing work.

combination.zh: 组合创意：飞艇厨房在颠簸时改变传送带方向，队友需要切换既定交接协议，而不只是提高移动速度。
combination.en: Design proposal: turbulence reverses airship-kitchen belts, requiring teams to switch handoff protocols.

setup.zh: 两位厨师共用一个切菜台，煎锅另一侧的人一直等不到原料。
setup.en: Two cooks share one chopping station; the cook by the pan keeps waiting for ingredients.

action.zh: 你们约定一人切菜、一人烹调，并把中间台作为交接点。
action.en: Assign one cook to chopping and the other to cooking, using a central counter for handoffs.

result.zh: 原料流动更稳定，但中间台满了就必须停下调整。
result.en: Ingredients flow more reliably, but a full handoff counter forces an adjustment.

next.zh: 新订单改变瓶颈时临时补位，再恢复分工。
next.en: Help the bottleneck when a new order changes demand, then resume roles.

firstStep.zh: 先做同屏双人、两个岗位和一个交接格；只验证传递与堵塞，不加入联网。
firstStep.en: Begin with two local players, two stations and one handoff slot; test passing and blockage without networking.

pitfall.zh: 联网同步、自由物理碰撞和大量菜谱会同时扩大范围，应与岗位协作分开验证。
pitfall.en: Networking, free physics and a large menu multiply scope; test role coordination separately.

test.zh: 观察两人是否主动约定交接位置，并在某岗位积压时调整分工。
test.en: Watch whether players establish a handoff location and redistribute work when one station backs up.
